template.name: GetTableDetailed
template.description: Retrieve table information with related nodes and attributes using tableByIdentifier query
template.query:
query GetTableDetailed($identifier: String!) {
  tableByIdentifier(identifier: $identifier) {
    id
    identifier
    description
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    tableNodeCount
    attributeCount
    attributes {
      id
      identifier
      description
      dataType
      isRequired
      defaultValue
    }
    tableNodes {
      id
      content
      title
      description
      createdAt
      updatedAt
    }
  }
}
